p.src: 1  He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

en: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
u.src: 1  He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

p.src: 2  I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

en: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
u.src: 2  I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

p.src: 3  For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

ja: の罠から、 命を奪う
en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
u.src: 3  For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

p.src: 4  He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

en: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
u.src: 4  He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

p.src: 5  You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

en: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
u.src: 5  You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

p.src: 6  nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

en: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
u.src: 6  nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

p.src: 7  A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

ja: れても、 それはあなたに
en: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
u.src: 7  A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

p.src: 8  You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

en: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
u.src: 8  You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

p.src: 9  Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

en: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
u.src: 9  Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

p.src: 10  no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

en: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
u.src: 10  no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

p.src: 11  For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

ja: じ、 あなたのすべての
en: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
u.src: 11  For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

p.src: 12  They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

ja: ちつけられないようにする。
en: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
u.src: 12  They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

p.src: 13  You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

ja: とコブラを踏み、 若い獅子と
en: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
u.src: 13  You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

p.src: 14  “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

ja: がわたしに心を結んだので、わたしは
en: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
u.src: 14  “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

p.src: 15  He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

en: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
u.src: 15  He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

p.src: 16  I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

en: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
u.src: 16  I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
